title: ofw - fractional work for the AI era

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if AI enables fractional work — where skills are rented like code? How might that reshape labor in the AI era?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Today, microservices and cloud functions let developers rent compute power. AI models can now be modular, trained once, used anywhere — like a plug-and-play tool.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But this risks eroding worker agency. If AI handles routine tasks, who defines value? Will people become interchangeable parts in an algorithmic economy?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are experimenting with tokenized skill-sharing and DAOs to ensure fair compensation and transparency in AI-assisted labor markets.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where people earn income through AI-augmented micro-tasks, with earnings tracked on decentralized ledgers and reinvested in personal upskilling.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of work may be fluid — powered by AI, but guided by human purpose and ethical design.

video_cue: A montage of diverse workers using AI tools on laptops, with glowing data streams and collaborative digital interfaces.
